speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Hepatopathy secondary to an Atrial Septal Defect (ASD).

The echocardiogram confirms an atrial septal defect, which explains the persistent cardiomegaly and the right-sided heart failure signs of liver enlargement and edema. Given the normal BNP and LDH, this is consistent with chronic volume overload rather than acute decompensated heart failure.
